statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail holds the low band because December NQ futures at 31,046.00 are 253 points above the 30,792.50 session low with no fresh extreme after the cash close, while volatility, the 10-year yield and crude all finished below their session highs. Stress stays elevated on a 3.4% semiconductor decline and a 3.64% advance in crude.
recommendation: Tail at 18 maps to EA_ON, one point above the previous hour, because the evening session has held a narrow 30,995.00 to 31,054.50 band and the 30,792.50 futures low is unchallenged, while Stress remains elevated on the energy and long-end backdrop. The narrow danger window is retained at 23:00Z to 02:00Z, covering the Tokyo and Seoul cash opens that price the OpenAI revenue revision and today's 3.4% semiconductor decline for the first time. A chip-led Asian gap that extends without retracement, or a sustained break of 30,792.50, is the stated invalidation of this reading. Existing-position management and protective logic are unaffected by this mapped state.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold a narrow evening range above the session low after an orderly close, keeping Tail in the low band while a semiconductor de-rating and a 3.64% crude advance hold Stress elevated
body: Cash NDX closed 30,725.81, down 434.27 points or 1.39%, a second consecutive decline, after a Financial Times report that OpenAI's annualized revenue is roughly 20 billion dollars below figures previously circulated. The gap is attributed to net-versus-gross treatment of cloud-partner revenue rather than a demand reversal, and the run rate is still reported up more than 70% since the start of the third quarter. Semiconductors carried the de-rating, with the chip gauge down 3.4%, Oracle off about 5.5%, Intel 5.3% and Nvidia 2.9%, while the Dow added 0.1% and the S&P 500 lost 0.47%, a rotation rather than a broad risk-off. The cross-asset backdrop is the source of elevated Stress: WTI settled 91.04 after a 3.64% advance and Brent 103.70 as Iranian attacks on Strait of Hormuz tankers intensified and Gulf of Mexico output was shut in ahead of a storm, while today's 30-year auction stopped at 5.618% against a 5.308% prior. What keeps Tail in the low band is that none of those amplifiers held its extreme into the close: VIX finished 15.41 against a 16.46 high, the 10-year eased to 5.23% from 5.33%, crude closed below its intraday peak, and the index itself closed 169 points above its low. December NQ futures print 31,046.00 at 22:16:49Z, 253 points clear of the 30,792.50 futures low and inside a 59.50-point band since the evening reopen, which is two-way behaviour rather than persistent directional efficiency. Shared Finviz context was not usable this run: the published file carries a collection time of 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z with partial status, far outside the 90-minute freshness limit, so this assessment rests entirely on independently verified primary sources.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. The overnight stretch to 05:00Z held Tail between 10 and 12 with Stress drifting up from 47 to 53. Tail first reached the watch band at 07:00Z on a trend-down read, held 20 to 23 through the European and early U.S. session, and peaked at 28 with Stress 72 at 17:00Z around the 30-year auction. It then unwound to 21 and 22 through the afternoon and returned to the low band at 18 and 17 for the 20:00Z and 21:00Z hours as the cash close proved orderly.
outlookSummary: The published path keeps Tail inside the low and watch bands across all 24 hours, peaking at 22 twice. The first peak is the 23:00Z to 02:00Z danger window, where Tokyo and Seoul price the OpenAI revision and the 3.4% semiconductor decline for the first time and a chip-led gap could extend. The second is the 13:00Z to 14:00Z cluster on Friday, where a cash open following two consecutive declines meets Michigan preliminary sentiment and inflation expectations at 14:00Z into 91 crude. Between those, Asian mid-session and European morning hours step back toward 18 and 19 on the assumption that opening imbalances revert. Confidence declines from 87 to 76 across the window as the verified evidence base ages. The reading is invalidated by a sustained break of the 30,792.50 futures low or by repeated extension after failed retracements.

forecastDetail.comment: December NQ futures at 31,046.00 as of 22:16:49Z sit 253 points above the 30,792.50 session low and above the 31,020.50 reopen, inside a 59.50-point evening band, while cash NDX closed 30,725.81 some 169 points clear of its 30,556.40 low. With VIX at 15.41 against a 16.46 high, the 10-year back to 5.23% from 5.33% and crude below its intraday peak, every Tail amplifier finished the session fading rather than aligning.

The final pre-Asia hour is a handover rather than a catalyst: the 30,995.00 evening floor is the near reference and 30,792.50 the stated invalidation, with the Asian chip complex yet to price today's 3.4% semiconductor decline and Hormuz headline flow still an open overnight gap channel.

Tokyo and Seoul price the OpenAI revenue revision for the first time through Advantest, Tokyo Electron and SK Hynix. The reported shortfall reflects net-versus-gross cloud-partner accounting rather than a demand collapse, and the run rate is still reported up over 70% since the start of Q3, so an orderly gap that fills is the base case and an extending gap without retracement is the invalidation.

The second Asian hour is where an opening gap either fills or becomes trend. Repeated extension after a failed first retracement with NQ pinned near a new low is the specific structure that would lift Tail out of the watch band; orderly two-way discovery keeps it inside, with oil and yields the cross-asset confirmation.

Asian mid-session normally restores two-way flow once the opening auction clears, and the published step down assumes exactly that. A sustained break of the overnight low would invalidate the assumption rather than confirm it.

With the Asian open behind, the dominant input is whether crude holds near 91.04 after a 3.64% advance and Brent near 103.70. On this contract energy-led cost pressure is a Stress and Confidence input rather than a mechanical Tail amplifier, and Hormuz tanker traffic at its lowest since late July keeps that channel open without yet turning the NQ path one-way.
